title: WhatsApp Business: Your Best Sales Tool
excerpt: How to use WhatsApp to serve customers and sell more. Configure your profile like a professional.
author: Tu Emprendimiento
content:
WhatsApp Business is probably the most underestimated tool by Paraguayan entrepreneurs.

**Automated responses**
Set up a welcome message that sends automatically.

**Product catalog**
WhatsApp Business has a built-in catalog. Upload your products with photos and prices.

**Labels to organize**
Use labels to classify your clients: new, follow-up, frequent.

**Scheduled messages**
If you need to send reminders, schedule them for when you want them sent.
